fields.Name: C1 -> S9.2
fields.Description: Gate G3.7 (owner PR 4, phase 3, dataset C1, criterion S9.2): 10 of 10 numbers sampled from the C1 model story and the model detail's trust line trace to a stored metric row and recompute from it. C1 trains on its reference split (the as-of assembly pipeline under C1ReferenceProtocol) and is evaluated through the lifecycle gate; the pool is every TracedNumber the experiment report renders (regenerated from the run and model rows through ExperimentReports.InputFromRows) and every number the trust line renders (evidence count and headline comparison). Ten are drawn without replacement with mulberry32 seeded 42; each is re-read from its row by entity and ID (MJ: ML Training Runs.ValidationResults, MJ: ML Models.FeatureImportance), recomputed at its JSON path within 1e-12 relative, found in its rendered text, and its token checked to print the stored value at its precision. Mutation: the report's Primary Metric computed as score x 0.98 -> a sampled number does not recompute.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 10 sampled numbers from the C1 report and trust line each recompute from their stored row, 10 of 10.
